title: QUIC: add support for draft-ietf-quic-version-negotiation-03
description:
Add an helper to ease of adding version fields to protocol tree


(cherry picked from commit 9c9376fa016ec83dcbae24b448fc3fe9952f64d2)

notes.body: Is this really a bug fix and not a feature?

Good question: technically it is a new feature, no doubts about that, IMO.

Some time ago, I asked @alagoutte about back-porting rules and he replied with something like: "the idea is only back-port fixes (and not enhance...); but for QUIC it is complicated; is a new draft a fix or enhance?" (@alagoutte will correct me If I reported that wrongly).

I have successfully back-ported to 3.4 all the patches related to the new versions of all the "official" QUIC drafts, like version-negotiation.

Nonetheless, if someone is really doing some QUIC work with Wireshark, he should use current master anyway...

I don't have strong opinions on that and definitely it is not my call...
No backport for this change (it is an enhance)
